basic.description:
{Basic Runes}

Basic Runes allow hero's units to accumulate up to 3 Rune Levels in combat. Each Rune Level gives bonuses to the creature stats:

{1}: +2 attack, {2}: +2 defence, {3}: +1 speed.

The bonuses of all achieved Rune Levels are cumulative. The unit gains +1 Rune Level when it attacks; +2 Rune Levels when it takes damage; +3 Rune Levels when it takes a defensive stance.
